model_annotation: Figure 4 illustrates the performance of knowledge co-occurrence methods on long-tailed biomedical datasets, displaying how often the predictions of the post-edit models remain unchanged for out-of-scope neighbor groups. The x-axis, labeled “Co-occurrence Number,” is a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 10^6, with tick labels spaced linearly and displaying values from 68.42 to 83.70. The y-axis, labeled “ACC (%)”, is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 65, with tick labels spaced linearly and displaying values from 33.70 to 65.00. A solid black line represents the “Base” method, starting at a value of 57.60 and gradually declining to 33.70. A dashed green line represents the “MEMIT” method, beginning at 86.21 and decreasing to 47.36. A solid blue line represents the "ROME" method, beginning at 98.64 and ending at 84.62. A dashed red line represents the “IKE” method, starting at 89.60 and declining to 83.70. A solid purple line represents the “FT” method, beginning at 32.52, increasing to 96.80.
